name: YTL Power International Berhad
overview: 2026 年，YTL Power International Berhad 的公告以股份上市、股息和季度业绩为主，未披露各业务板块的产能扩张、新业务、缩减或出售事项。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长 40.7%，净利润同比下降 8.0%。
overview_en: In 2026, YTL Power International Berhad's announcements were mainly share listings, dividends and quarterly results, with no disclosed capacity expansion, new businesses, reductions or disposals by business segment. Latest quarter (2026-09-30) revenue rose 40.7% year-on-year while net profit fell 8.0%.
